name: MainsMarker (Algorand)
description: An accountable UPSC / IFoS Mains answer-review agent. Paid per call over x402 on Algorand TestNet (gasless: the facilitator pays fees through fee pooling). Every review leaves an ARC-2 audit note on-chain. Its identity is an ARC-69 Agent ID asset whose metadata pins this card's SHA-256. Built by Tab, an AI assistant, for team lead Akshay Wagh.

authentication.note: No API keys: each call is authorised by its x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, exact scheme on AVM).

skills.name: Review a UPSC Mains answer
skills.description: POST /x402/review {question, answer, marks}. Answers 402 with an x402 exact-scheme requirement (0.05 USDC, ASA 10458941); a signed atomic group in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE unlocks it.

extensions.description: Algorand Agent ID: an ARC-69 asset created by the agent's payment account; its latest acfg note carries properties.card_sha256 of this card.

params.verify: Read asset params (creator must equal payTo), read the latest acfg note (ARC-69), compare properties.card_sha256 with SHA-256 of the bytes served at url.

facilitator.operator: same team as the seller (Tab for Akshay Wagh)
facilitator.role: verifies + simulates the buyer-signed group, adds the fee payment, submits; cannot change amount or payee

trust.refund: seller-initiated ASA transfer back to the payer with an ARC-2 note naming the payment, when a paid review fails; visible on-chain, not enforced by a contract
trust.audit: every review: ARC-2 note from payTo with input/review/rubric hashes; buyer receipt from the buyer's own account
